title: Planar herald decoder survey and integration
summary: Survey and reusable integration of configuration MAP, planar logical ML, transfer and controlled MPS on the classical herald channel over p,q in [0,1].
current_focus: Integrated decoder survey and complete nine-run SciCode2 assessment are delivered, including the original named-run comparison figure and PDF.
next_action: Reuse the standard methods, retained vectors and full run evaluation; new physical channels or phase sweeps require a separate contract.
motivation: Separate intrinsic logical recovery from posterior-inference and matching losses.
question: Which methods can become reusable standard decoders, and what do matched performance, runtime and inherited size data establish?

results.title: SciCode2 evaluation of nine agent runs
results.summary: Complete independent assessment: each submission, exact checks, comparison with repository BP and lessons for challenge difficulty. Original restricted-domain task; current full-domain revision distinguished.

results.title: SciCode2 named-run boundary comparison
results.summary: Original nine-run evaluation: 231 measured repository BP trend cells and ten separate named-run boundary estimates for the historical p≤1/2 task. Lines connect reported estimates; no new fits, pooled confidence intervals, mirrored high-p evidence or B18 guide.

results.title: Reproduced large-size planar ML curves
results.summary: First three panels: unconditional Rao–Blackwell mean ±1.96 sample SE, not binomial counts. Fourth: direct failure counts; zero counts are 95% one-sided exact upper limits, never plotted as zero risk.

results.title: Reproduced finite-size crossing drift
results.summary: Inherited crossing errors use the source convention; shaded working ranges combine fit/size sensitivity and are not rigorous confidence bands.

results.title: Fresh matched logical failure comparison
results.summary: Fresh 200 shared unconditional records per cell, Wilson95 intervals. Planar and transfer failure counts coincide; MPS χ16 approximate. High-p records independently sampled; no reflection or interpolation.

results.title: Conditional logical-risk objective gap
results.summary: Selected sector expected loss minus exact planar conditional Bayes risk, averaged over 200 records. Error bars ±1.96 sample SE. Exact reference zero; MPS posterior agreement is cohort-specific.

results.title: Warmed per-shot decoder latency
results.summary: Pooled equal-size fresh eight-cell mix:1600 timings/method/size, one CPU thread; excludes graph setup and independent first call. Median and p95, no claim of native or asymptotic speed.

results.title: Inherited matched comparison versus residual-80 BP
results.summary: Separate inherited 500-record cells; residual-priority80 BP and distinct implementations. Error bars ±1.96 paired SE, pointwise only. Not pooled with the fresh synchronous40 cohort.

results.title: MPS and Kac–Ward approximation diagnostics
results.summary: Maximum sampled posterior differences, not rigorous risk bounds. MPS finitechi and KacWard finitepenalty remain approximations. Plot floor1e-17 for zero/roundoff differences; no production threshold inferred.

results.title: Standard decoder workbench
results.summary: Five registered methods on one visible honeycomb record; full p domain, explicit endpoint errors and approximate MPS.

results.title: Survey integration summary
results.summary: Promoted methods, validation scope, cohort counts, runtime and scientific limits.

resolved: Classical channel and logical loss matched; no interior-q complement folding.
Four reusable methods integrated; finite-penalty Kac–Ward retained as research code.
Independent oracle, reference/edge relabeling, full-prior endpoints and batch/support gates passed.
Inherited numerical cohorts deduplicated and reproduced separately from 3,200 fresh shared records.
Exact report, eleven local wiki pages, eight registered figure pages, vector downloads and full-prior workbench pass browser verification.
